Home
Industries
Hospitality & Events
Access guest-services professionals, shift managers, and operations talent who understand seasonal surges, frontline workforce management, and the art of creating exceptional guest experiences.
Key market data and trends shaping talent demand in your industry. (Hover for details)
US hospitality industry revenue including hotels, restaurants, and events
Annual employee turnover in hospitality, highest of any industry
Unfilled hospitality positions across hotels, restaurants, and venues
Peak-to-trough staffing fluctuation during holiday and wedding seasons
Start a risk-free pilot and receive qualified candidates in 14 days.
A tailored workflow for the challenges of hospitality & events settings.
We assess your property type, seasonal peaks, and service standards.
Candidates evaluated for guest experience orientation, not just task completion.
Availability confirmed for weekends, holidays, split shifts, and overnight coverage.
Service-minded professionals placed and ready to deliver exceptional guest experiences.

Hotels, restaurants, and resorts face the highest turnover rate of any industry at 73%. Every departure means retraining, service gaps, and guest complaints. You need reliable professionals who can step in and deliver from the first shift.

Seasonal demand is extreme. Summer resort bookings, holiday restaurant surges, wedding season at venues, and conference hotel blocks all demand 2-3x your base staffing. Year-round headcount does not solve seasonal peaks.

Frontline hospitality is not task completion. It is guest experience. You need shift managers who can run a floor, front desk staff who can upsell, event coordinators who can handle crises, and kitchen managers who can maintain quality under pressure.
Hotel operations: front desk, housekeeping management, revenue management, and guest relations
Restaurant management: FOH managers, kitchen coordinators, and F&B directors with high-volume experience
Resort staffing: activities coordinators, spa managers, and concierge professionals
Event staffing: planners, day-of coordinators, catering managers, and venue operations
Shift-ready professionals who can cover weekends, holidays, and overnight schedules
We understand the unique challenges of your industry and deliver matching talent.
Every professional understands hospitality means creating memories, not just filling shifts.
Last-minute call-out? Event emergency? We mobilize experienced hospitality talent within hours.
Ramp from base to peak staffing for holidays, wedding season, or conference blocks without permanent overhead.
From lobby to kitchen to ballroom: front desk, F&B, events, housekeeping, and management roles.
Pre-vetted professionals, delivered weekly, ready to start.
- Luxury Resort Hotel, 250 rooms

TaaSFlow gives hospitality leaders a workspace for every hire — property leadership, F&B, guest experience, operations — with rubrics tuned to property type, service level and operating model.

Service level captured in intake
Scope of ownership evidence from the CV

TaaSFlow gives hospitality leaders a workspace for every hire — property leadership, F&B, guest experience, operations — with rubrics tuned to property type, service level and operating model.
Property type and segment rubric
Service level captured in intake
Scope of ownership evidence from the CV
Luxury, lifestyle, select-service and F&B-led operations each need distinct signal. Our rubric captures the property types the candidate has actually operated in.
Service standards, cover counts and guest-experience expectations vary widely. We capture them in intake so shortlists reflect the operating reality of the property.
Multi-unit leadership rewards different signal than single-property GM work. Rubrics per seat surface the actual scope of ownership on the CV.
We calibrate the rubric to the seniority and specialisation you actually need.
